marta: Heads-up — during sylph-22b quant bring-up I hit a deterministic drift after ~1k tokens on Q4_0 pipeline. generation stays fine until ~1024 then outputs start to diverge from fp16 baseline and hallucinate. seen on both local runtime and dedicated canary.

marta: Repro command:```bash
python bench/repro.py --model sylph-22b-q4_0 --input tests/long_prompt.txt --max_new_tokens 512 --dump-kv=kv_dump.npz
```

marta: Quick log snippet (trimmed):```
[2026-03-19 14:12:03] step=1008 token=... logits_l2_diff=0.0012
[2026-03-19 14:12:10] step=1024 token=... logits_l2_diff=0.21  <-- big jump
[2026-03-19 14:12:11] subsequent_tokens diverge, repeated phrases
```

ryan: Can you attach the kv_dump.npz? also which runtime variant? s3 path or upload here works. @marta this sounds like a KV state alignment issue vs rotary/rope offsets.

marta: uploaded to s3://redwood-sylph/onboard/2101234567/kv_dump.npz and baseline fp16 run at s3://.../fp16_kv.npz. runtime=rv1.3 with cutlass kernels.

ryan: Thanks. First quick checks: 1) compare KV buffer shapes/strides 2) compare raw attention scores for head 3 at step 1023 vs 1024 3) check if rotary scaling/offset implementation differs between q4 codepath and fp16.

devon: fyi we've seen a similar symptom when custom quant-dequant path uses half-precision scale factors placed with different alignment — leads to small per-step bias that accumulates with long KV reuse. sequence length threshold ~1024/2048 tends to trigger. I'll look at the kernel selection logs.

sarah: Eval numbers: run on long_book_eval (200 samples, avg ctx 1.7k): fp16 ppl=10.2, q8_0 ppl=10.5, q4_0 ppl=12.4 (regression). exact-match on LM-head at 512 tokens drops ~6% for q4_0 vs fp16.

marta: Quick binary diff of attention outputs (head 3, layer 10) before/after failure:```python
# load kvs and compare
import numpy as np
a=np.load('fp16_kv.npz')['attn_scores']
b=np.load('kv_dump.npz')['attn_scores']
print('max_abs', np.max(np.abs(a-b)))
print('l2', np.linalg.norm(a-b))
```
Outputs: max_abs=0.0008 up to step 1008 then jumps to max_abs=0.25 at step 1024.
```

ryan: If attn scores diverge that much, check rotary phase increments. In our impl we apply rope as: q *= rotary.cos + rotate(q)*rotary.sin with incremental phase table. If the q/k packing order for q4 kernel is different (e.g., interleaved pairs vs contiguous) you can end up applying the phase to wrong dims. Also confirm kv cache write-index is using the same dtype and stride.

devon: kernel logs from node:```
SELECT KERNEL: attention_qk_cutlass_sm80_quant -> chosen
KV_ALLOC: stride_bytes=131072, expected=131072
QUANTIZE_PATH: fast_q4 -> scale_align=16
BUG? buffer_offset computed from seq_len*head_dim maybe overflow on 32-bit multiply
```
I'll run a small reproducer to check offset arithmetic.

kevin: Priority: make hosted fallback to q8_0 for sylph-22b and mark this P1 for model-onboard. @marta @ryan own the triage? can we get a minimal reproducer that CI can run? If we can assert on attn score l2 < 1e-3 until full-precision match, we can gate.

marta: I can add a minimized unit test that streams 1.5k tokens and asserts head-by-head L2 < 1e-3 vs fp16 for first 1k tokens, and then check no sudden jumps at >1k. pushing PR in a bit: PR link: https://git.redwood/models/pulls/4271 (WIP).

sarah: Also running quantization sensitivity sweep to see if Q4_0 variant or our custom range clipping is the culprit. preliminary: q4_0 w/ per-channel scales reduces reg but still off.

ryan: For triage plan: 1) repro and minimal unit test (marta) 2) kernel offset/stride audit (devon) 3) rotary/rope codepath comparison between q4 and fp16 (ryan) 4) bake a CI canary that runs long prompt smoke end-to-end and pins q8 fallback if fails (kevin).

devon: found one suspicious thing — in quant path we call cudaMemsetAsync on kv buffer using bytes not elements in one codepath; that can leave garbage tail when stride != contiguous. patch incoming.

marta: Thanks. I'll wait for kernel patch and then run the repro. If we can get deterministic pass on local rv1.3 I'll re-run hosted canary.

deploybot: canary: sylph-22b-q8_0 fallback enabled for hosted group 'onboard-alpha' at 2026-03-19T14:28:19Z :white_check_mark:

kevin: Nice. Keep updates here. If devon confirms kernel patch, mark uplink to runtime release train. After fix, we need an automated regression test in eng-ml/ci/long_context_smoke that runs on every runtime release.

marta: adding test and a short checklist to the PR description: - reproducible script + kv dumps - head-level attn comparisons - patch verification instructions - rollback/fallback steps - assign runtime owner - schedule canary run

ryan: one more note — add utterance-level checksum for kv state (sha1 over float bytes) so we can quickly compare across runs without shipping full .npz. small helper in bench/repro.py.

marta: done, pushed helper. I'll post results once kernel patch lands. :pray:
